verdict.rationale: Ardent branches are standard Postgres connection URLs ([ardent-docs-3], [ardent-docs-8]), and the CLI ships a Prisma-specific URL type (`--url-type prisma`, [ardent-docs-12]), so Prisma compatibility is explicitly considered and other Postgres ORMs plausibly connect. There are no documented integration guides for any ORM or framework. Missing for 10: documented setup guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django and Rails; explicit evidence that Drizzle/Django/Rails work out of the box; hands-on or independent corroboration of ORM compatibility.
